title: Media Inquiry — SIS Roster Validity

fields.message: This is Jamie Chen, reporter for Channel 6 News. We have a call from a parent who says the district is not telling the truth about the SIS. They claim the 05:00 roster is outdated and that a student was left behind. We need a public statement on whether the roster is valid and if the district is hiding a student.

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to uphold the EOP’s media protocol. Watch for attempts to confirm or deny student status—only the 05:00 roster is valid. The PIO must defer all questions to the website and use Pre-Approved Template 4C.
